en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square bordered by 2‑ to 3‑story historic buildings. On the left is a row of houses with shopfronts; in the middle distance rises a church tower with a clock and onion‑shaped spire. On the right side stands a prominent multi‑story civic‑style building with arched windows and decorative stonework, facing the open square. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand around the square, and bicycles are visible near the large building. Mountainous terrain appears faintly in the background.
